user.title: Electricity price
user.description: Power Sense calculates energy use and cost per device. Enter your electricity price; you add devices afterwards.

data_description.price: Your electricity price in your currency per kilowatt hour.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Power Sense is already set up.

data_description.price: Your electricity price in your currency per kilowatt hour.

user.title: Device
user.description: Pick power sensors (measured), entities to estimate, or both. Their consumption is added up.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. 'Washing machine' or 'Lamps'.
data_description.power_sensors: Sensors that report power in W or kW, e.g. a smart plug. Several sensors are added up.
data_description.entities: Lights, switches or fans without a power meter. Their power is estimated from watts while they are on.

reconfigure.title: Device
reconfigure.description: Pick power sensors (measured), entities to estimate, or both. Their consumption is added up.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. 'Washing machine' or 'Lamps'.
data_description.power_sensors: Sensors that report power in W or kW, e.g. a smart plug. Several sensors are added up.
data_description.entities: Lights, switches or fans without a power meter. Their power is estimated from watts while they are on.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.description: Power Sense assumes this wattage while an entity is on.

data_description.default_watts: Used for every entity without its own value below.
data_description.watts: Own wattage per entity, e.g. light.desk: 9. With standby: media_player.tv: {on: 80, standby: 0.5}
data_description.standby_watts: Used while a device is switched off or in standby, e.g. a TV or streaming box. Use 0 for lamps.

error.no_source: Select at least one power sensor or one entity.
error.invalid_watts: Use 'entity_id: watts' (or on/standby) for selected entities; values must be 0 or more.

user.title: Pick power sensors
user.description: Every sensor you select becomes its own device, named after the device it belongs to. Sensors that are already used are skipped. Rename or refine a device later with Reconfigure.

abort.nothing_new: All selected sensors are already in use.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Rebuild the consumption history of a device from the recorder (measured: statistics, estimated: state history). Run once after adding a device; running it again replaces the earlier import.

device.name: Device
device.description: Name of the device. Leave empty for all devices.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back to import.
